# AltBots

> Agentic AI portfolio monitoring platform for institutional allocators — continuous risk scoring, manager intelligence, liquidity oversight, and tax intelligence across 1,500+ managers.

AltBots runs autonomous agents that synthesize K-1s, 1099s, SEC filings, fund admin feeds, and legislative trackers into a single portfolio command center. This is a public demo with fictional data ("Wynfield").

## Pages

- [Portfolio Overview](/): Top-level KPIs, alerts, and agent activity across the portfolio.
- [Holdings & Performance](/performance): NAV, exposure, correlation, and risk metrics for institutional analytics.
- [Liquidity](/liquidity): Cash balances, capital waterfalls, pacing, and stress testing.
- [Manager Grid](/managers): Searchable grid of all monitored managers with risk scoring.
- [Manager Detail](/manager/4): Institutional deep-dive on a single manager with intelligence tabs.
- [Tax Intelligence](/tax-intelligence): Tax KPIs, PPLI risk, residency audit, K-1 pipeline, and structural watch list.
- [Analyst & Personas](/analyst): Claude-powered AI analyst chat for due diligence on the embedded dataset.
- [Interconnection Map](/connections): 3D force-directed visualization of portfolio relationships.
